Hi!
I'm Adam, a Bayesian statistician and data scientist.
I like working on impactful problems where careful statistical thinking matters.
If you'd like to collaborate or just chat, get in touch.

I work with the [Center for Forecasting and Outbreak Analytics](https://www.cdc.gov/forecast-outbreak-analytics/index.html) at CDC on epidemic surveillance.
My current focus is on building daily, county-level estimates of the [reproduction number](https://www.cdc.gov/forecast-outbreak-analytics/about/rt-estimates.html) using [GAMs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Generalized_additive_model).
Previously, I developed and applied [tools](https://github.com/epinowcast/epidist) for estimating delay distributions.

I also support [Active Site](https://activesite.bio/) on the design and analysis of studies evaluating real world AI assistance for biological tasks [e.g. @hong2026measuring].

#### Background

I completed my [PhD](https://github.com/athowes/thesis) "Bayesian spatio-temporal methods for small-area estimation of HIV indicators" at [Imperial College London](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/) on the [StatML CDT](https://statml.io/) with [Seth Flaxman](https://sethrf.com/) and [Jeffrey Imai-Eaton](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/people/jeffrey.eaton).
I worked on comparing models for area-level spatial correlation, estimating district-level HIV risk group proportions [@howes2023spatio; [SHIPP](https://hivtools.unaids.org/shipp/)], and developing Bayesian inference methods [@howes2025fast].

I've been a visiting researcher at the [MIT Media Lab](https://www.media.mit.edu/groups/sculpting-evolution/overview/) contributing to the [Nucleic Acid Observatory](https://www.naobservatory.org/) project for detecting biological threats, and at the [University of Waterloo](https://uwaterloo.ca/statistics-and-actuarial-science/) working on adaptive quadrature methods.
After my PhD, I worked at the [University of Oxford](https://www.ox.ac.uk/) modelling food security with the [WFP](https://www.wfp.org/) [@ishida2025realtime], and helped develop an [individual-based model](https://github.com/mrc-ide/helios) for [Blueprint Biosecurity](https://blueprintbiosecurity.org/) to quantify the public health impact of indoor air quality interventions, including far UVC [@howes2026measuring].
